cells.gaps: The 336 communes (MDG-007, December 2025) are given as 40% of the project's target, not as a share of all communes, so the count is a floor; the newer fact (MDG-005, 2026-03-02) says only 'several communes'. MDG-009 does not say in terms where the record is held, and the offline module was only in demonstration. The plan held is the national decentralisation plan to 2030, which carries digital civil-status centres as an indicator (MDG-042); no domestic budget line is held, and PRODIGY's financing closed on 30 June 2026 with no later fact on what funds the system; the software's future after OpenCRVS stops was unsettled. No digital death registration is reported.
cells.note: SIECM is live for births in communes that use it themselves, past pilot, on a count with no denominator, which is stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of offices on a share or a count with a denominator.
